fullContentHtml:
UPSC Geo Scientist Marks 2026 – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the marks for the post of Combined Geo Scientist Pre Examination 2025 on the official website of UPSC. This recruitment was released for 85 posts. Applications for the UPSC Geo-Scientist Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 03 September 2025 to 23 September 2025. The mains examination was conducted on 20-21 June 2026. Candidates who qualified the Mains examination can download their UPSC Geo-Scientist Marks 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 September 2025
  • Last Date : 23 September 2025
  • Pre Exam Date : 08 February 2026
  • Pre Admit Card : 30 January 2026
  • Result : 02 March 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 20-21 June 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 12 June 2026
  • Mains Result : 20 July 2026
  • Marks : 30 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST, Female : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

UPSC Geo Scientist Marks 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
